neighbours.label: noun subject of an 'it is ending' predicate: 'the wait is over', 'X's days are numbered'
fire: Gamers rejoice, because the wait is over and the sequel is out today.
For patients on the list, the long wait is finally over.
Fans of the band can relax now: the wait is over.
Critics say the dictator's days are numbered after the protests.
With streaming everywhere, the video store's days may be numbered.
After months of delays, the wait is over for commuters.
Many believe the old coal plant's days are numbered.
After a decade, the wait is almost over for the new bridge.
quiet: Gamers rejoice, because the sequel is out today in every store.
For patients on the list, the surgery has finally happened.
Fans of the band can relax now: the tour is confirmed.
Critics say the dictator's power is weakening after the protests.
With streaming everywhere, the video store has fewer customers.
After months of delays, the trains are running for commuters.
Many believe the old coal plant will keep running for years.
After a decade, the weather was sunny for the opening of the bridge.

notes: Probe: 'the wait is finally over' 0.95, 'days may be numbered' 0.65, golden age was over 0.24, plain 'the wait at the clinic' 0.31, 'weight is off' 0.16, 'days are getting longer' 0.08. Quiet items avoid the noun wait entirely.
